verdict.rationale: WorkOS Directory Sync documents SCIM support. It sends automatic updates for changes to directories, groups, users and access rules via webhooks or the Events API, and lets IT admins activate and deactivate accounts and create groups that inform access rules. Several independent HN users praise its SCIM wrapper and configuration wizard. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that IdP deprovisioning automatically revokes active app sessions or access (the evidence shows deactivation events delivered to the app, not end-to-end revocation), and detailed deprovisioning event semantics.
